verdict.rationale: Lovable documents iterative follow-up prompting in Build mode: you can send follow-ups or corrections at any time to steer the work, and changes are shown through file diffs and summaries. Per-person drafts give a separate copy of the project with its own chat and preview, which helps isolate changes. However, nothing in the pack documents a safeguard against regressions, such as preserving existing behavior, testing, or one-click revert of a bad prompt. Missing for 10: documented version history/rollback of AI edits, regression protection or testing of existing functionality, independent hands-on evidence that follow-up edits don't break working features.

support.subject: As a founder, I can refine my app through follow-up prompts without breaking what already works

citations.quote: Send a follow-up, a correction, or a new idea at any time to steer the work
All modifications are visible through file diffs and summaries.
each of you can work in your own draft: a separate copy of the project with its own chat and preview.
